title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.10.6
body_markdown:
*released August 13th, 2024*

### Summary of What's New in this Release

* Fixed a bug where the compiler was generating AVX vector comparison instructions during /arch:SSE or /arch:SSE2 compilation.
* Fixed a compiler crash that was reported against 17.10 when compiling nanobind v.1.9.2.
* Fixed regressions in the C++ compiler related to guaranteed copy elision in C++17 or later.
* Fixed an issue with miscompilation of template-template parameter packs.
* Fixed an issue in which the MSVC compiler could not compile some code in qtwebengine and instead emitted "C2100: you cannot dereference an operand of type 'v8::internal::compiler::turboshaft::WordRepresentation'".

### Developer Community

* [vs2022 17.10.0p7: MSVC code-gen bug for "ARM64|Release" on some loop constructs](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/vs2022-17100p7:-MSVC-code-gen-bug-for-/10661358)
* [Bug in x86 build inlining destructor with SPGO enabled](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Bug-in-x86-build-inlining-destructor-wit/10658747)
* [An AVX instruction is generated even if "Enabled Enhanced Instruction Set" sets to "Not Set"](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/An-AVX-instruction-is-generated-even-if-/10601714)
* [Internal compiler error w/ nanobind v1.9.2](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Internal-compiler-error-w-nanobind-v19/10662883)
* [VS 17.10: Spurious compile error C2102 ("&" requires l-value)](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/VS-1710:-Spurious-compile-error-C2102-/10666380)
* [QtWebEingine Compilation brings internal compiler error C2100](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/QtWebEingine-Compilation-brings-internal/10674103)
* [Show Structure Guidelines are missing in some areas in a VB.Net project after upgrade to Version 17.10.3.](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Show-Structure-Guidelines-are-missing-in/10686497)

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2024-38167**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-38167) A vulnerability exists in .NET runtime TlsStream which may result in Information Disclosure.
* [**CVE-2024-38168**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-38168) A vulnerability exists in .NET when an attacker through unauthenticated requests may trigger a Denial of Service in ASP.NET HTTP.sys web server. This is a windows OS only vulnerability.
